basics.name: Tanmay Agrawal
basics.label: Postdoctoral Research Fellow | Environmental Fluid Dynamics

work.name: University of Oxford
work.summary: Working with Prof. Thomas J. Aubry on the NERC-funded PHOENIX project, investigating buoyant multiphase plumes in stratified and sheared environments using laboratory experiments, integral modelling and large-eddy simulations.
highlights: Developing an analogue flow facility for laboratory studies of buoyant plumes in stratified crossflow.
Developing integral plume models and large-eddy simulation datasets to investigate plume dynamics, transport and entrainment under ambient stratification and velocity shear.

work.name: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi
work.summary: Investigated transport, mixing and entrainment in turbulent jets, fountains and air curtains using laboratory experiments, large-eddy simulations and Lagrangian transport analysis.
highlights: Developed experimental and numerical frameworks for studying turbulent impinging fountains and air curtains.
Investigated the physical mechanisms governing infiltration and transport across air curtains using Eulerian and Lagrangian analyses.

work.name: The University of Melbourne
work.summary: Investigated mixing in stratified gravity currents using high-resolution molecular tagging velocimetry and thermometry.
highlights: Performed simultaneous velocity and temperature measurements to quantify mixing in lock-exchange flows.
The resulting first-author Physics of Fluids article was selected as an Editor's Pick.

work.name: National Tsing Hua University
work.summary: Developed computational methods for incompressible fluid-flow simulation, including multigrid and GPU-based lattice Boltzmann solvers.
highlights: Developed an in-house multigrid solver for the unsteady incompressible Navier-Stokes equations.
Implemented GPU-accelerated lattice Boltzmann solvers and immersed-boundary methods for fluid-solid interaction problems.

projects.name: Field Measurement Campaign on Vande Bharat Express
projects.description: Joint IIT Delhi, Mitzvah and Indian Railways field study of air-curtain performance for passenger thermal comfort and indoor air quality.
highlights: Co-led an in-situ comparison of an air-curtain-equipped train coach against a reference coach during a full-day journey.
Contributed to distributed temperature measurements, anemometry, flow visualisation and analysis of spatio-temporal temperature fields.

projects.name: CFD Study on Slurry Mixing Optimisation
projects.description: Industry-collaborative computational study at National Tsing Hua University investigating slurry mixing in a stirred chamber.
highlights: Performed three-dimensional ANSYS Fluent simulations to evaluate the effects of chamber geometry on particle redistribution and mixing homogeneity.
